chapter_title: Concerning the Five Forms that exist in the Rulers

fills.notes: The sentence contrasts his bipedal gait with the smoke-world’s proper form; the next clause explicitly mentions the world of smoke, so the comparison phrase must precede it.
He alternates forms at will: walk (biped), then another locomotion on four (quadruped) corresponding to fire’s swift predation. “walk upon four” matches the following “four … on his hands and feet”.
The syntactic frame requires the number to govern a body-part term before “on his hands and feet.” The natural completion is “four (feet)”.
Fire-children correspond to vehement, rapid motion; after “on his hands and feet” a verb of swift movement is demanded before “like the children of fire.”

fills.fill: When he wishes, he shall gather
fills.notes: The “first” quality must be an active sovereign function over subordinate powers, parallel to the later qualities (conceal/reveal; invulnerability). “Gather” fits the correspondential idea of concentration/command.
Paired opposites are typical in this substrate (bind/loose; gather/disperse). It also prepares the second quality (hiding/showing) by the same inside→outside control logic.
The clause needs an infinitive construction: “Shall a … his magic arts.” In this register the point is concealment and sudden manifestation through art/word.
Adjusted from editor’s “wreak magic” to a more substrate-technical phrasing: effective speech produces operative change (word-as-force), not moral ‘wreaking’.
Connects the strength statement to the proof: nails/claws cannot penetrate. A causal linker is required here.
The comparison “No iron nor copper body will equal him …; they will not be able to destroy him” demands a measure of resistance/strength rather than a moral predicate.
The idiom “made like the likeness of fire” is a Coptic calque for complete assimilation of quality (here: fiery state) rather than mere appearance.
Parallelism with ¶9 requires the same term: assimilation to the snow/frost state.
The bracket is mid-word and already supplies the necessary letters; no restoration beyond reproducing them is warranted.

The line concludes a triad of faculties: fiery alteration, icy alteration, and mind-reading while present. The final sentence needs a concluding capability oriented to inevitable outcome: he ‘foresees’ the destruction set before him (i.e., the determined terminus).
Mid-word continuation; the letters supplied are the correct completion of “established be-”.

assessment: Most gaps are short connective or parallel-structure restorations constrained by the five-form locomotion sequence and the repeated triadic pattern. The main uncertainties remain ¶5–6 (the exact verbs naming the first quality and the phrasing around concealment by arts) and ¶11 #2 (the concluding faculty), where multiple substrate-consistent options exist.
